verdict.rationale: Manufact is an MCP hosting and deployment platform, so a server catalog is a fair axis. The only discovery evidence is a changelog note that users can 'browse public checklist scores at manufact.com/mcp-catalog', which implies a browsable public catalog oriented around publish-readiness scores. Server templates are a minor adjacent starting point. missing for 10: evidence of search or filtering by capability/tool, evidence the catalog is large, tool-level browsing, dedicated catalog documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
